Uttarakhand TET UTET Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Uttarakhand Board of School Education (UBSE) has released answer key for the recruitment of Uttarakhand Teacher Eligibility Test UTET Exam 2026 on the official website. Applications for the Uttarakhand TET UTET Online Form 2026 were accepted from July 14, 2026, to August 03, 2026. The written examination was held on 29 September 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their Uttarakhand TET UTET Answer Key 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 14 July 2026
  • Last Date : 03 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 August 2026
  • Modify Application Form : 08-11 August 2026
  • Exam Date : 29 September 2026
  • Admit Card : 11 September 2026
  • Answer Key : 11 September 2026

Application Fee

  • For Single Paper
  • UR, EWS, OBC : Rs. 600/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 300/-
  • For Both Paper
  • UR, EWS, OBC : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC, ST, PwBD : Rs. 500/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan

How to Check Answer Key

  1. Click on the official Answer Key link provided below.
  2. Select your Question Paper Series / Shift / Exam Date.
  3. Download the official Answer Key PDF.
  4. Compare your answers and submit objections if required before the deadline.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is Uttarakhand TET UTET Answer Key 2026?

Uttarakhand TET UTET Answer Key 2026 contains the official answers. Candidates can verify their responses and submit objections if required.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
